description: This file defines a final class `ContactsService` that implements contact management functionalities such as searching and adding contacts using the Contacts framework in iOS. It handles authorization, contact lookup by name, phone, or email, and contact creation, with encapsulation of contact payloads and external dependencies via imports.

classes.name: ContactsService
classes.description: A service class for managing iOS contacts including searching and adding contacts with proper authorization handling.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous search for contacts matching a query or retrieves contacts up to a limit if no query is provided.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new contact to the device's contact store, with checks for existing contacts based on phone or email.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Checks and manages contact store authorization status.

methods.name: authorizedStore
methods.description: Obtains an authorized CNContactStore instance, throwing an error if permission is not granted.

methods.name: normalizeStrings
methods.description: Normalizes an array of strings by trimming and optionally lowercasing.

methods.name: findExistingContact
methods.description: Finds an existing contact matching provided phone numbers or emails.

methods.name: matchContacts
methods.description: Matches contacts against normalized phone numbers and emails for duplication detection.

methods.name: normalizePhone
methods.description: Normalizes a phone number string to contain only digits.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Converts a CNContact to an OpenClawContactPayload struct for external use.
